query_text: Where can I buy the latest iPhone?

action.query: Apple latest iPhone buy iPhone official 2026
queries: Apple latest iPhone buy iPhone official 2026
Apple iPhone models buy official store

content.text:
You can buy the latest iPhone directly from **Apple** — online at the Apple Store or at a physical Apple Store. Apple’s current buy page lists the **iPhone 17 / iPhone 17 Pro / iPhone 17 Pro Max** lineup, with the iPhone 17 Pro models starting from **$1099**. ([apple.com](https://www.apple.com/us/shop/buy-iphone/iphone-17?utm_source=openai))

Good places to buy in the U.S.:

- **Apple Store / Apple.com** — best for unlocked phones, trade-in, iPhone Upgrade Program, AppleCare, and in-store pickup.
- **Major carriers** — Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile; often best if you want bill credits or a plan deal.
- **Authorized retailers** — Best Buy, Costco, Walmart, Target; useful for sales, pickup, or gift-card promos.

I’d avoid lookalike “Apple” sites — buy from **apple.com** or a known carrier/retailer.
